reader.requirement: At --std 85, `66 data-name-1 RENAMES data-name-2 THRU data-name-3` makes data-name-1 a group item spanning every elementary item from data-name-2 (its first elementary item when it is a group) to data-name-3 (its last elementary item when it is a group), including FILLER, intervening fixed tables and items of any usage, so that data-name-1 behaves as a group (no conversion on a move, alphanumeric comparison) in working-storage and file records alike.
reader.edition-search: grep of Edition./CobolVersion/DialectLevel/Has( over the RENAMES half of ResolveRedefinesPass.cs (lines 136-340: Edition.At and Edition.Error only), RedefinesModel.cs, ItemCategory.cs, VariableLengthCompatibility.cs, PlaceBuilder.cs, UsageCollectionPass.cs, PlaceRenderer.cs; the grammar rule renamesClause carries no edition predicate and VersionConformancePass.cs names no RENAMES node. The path consults the edition nowhere.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses span elementary data-name-2/data-name-3 over DISPLAY, BINARY and PACKED-DECIMAL leaves and a REDEFINES member; not exercised: a GROUP data-name-2 or data-name-3 (first/last elementary item), nested groups, FILLER and a fixed table inside the range, group comparison, qualification of data-name-1, file records, and the SR3/SR6/SR8 refusals

probes.printed: RGG (G1 THRU G2, both groups)=[abcdef]; RAE (A2 THRU C2, elementary into nested group)=[bcde]; RBG (B1 THRU G3, nested group as data-name-3)=[cdef]; MOVE "XYZ" TO RAE -> A1..C3 = a X Y Z ' ' f; MOVE 5 TO RBG -> [5   ]; RBD (G3 THRU D2, over FILLER, COMP-3, COMP) round-trip via X(10) keeps D1=-012 D2=0007; RGG = "XXXXXX" -> NE; RGG > 5 -> GT5 (alphanumeric comparison); MOVE ALL "q" TO RX -> C3=q E1=q; RGG OF R=[aXz   q]
probes.expected: the span runs from the first elementary item of data-name-2 to the last of data-name-3 and behaves as a group (GR1)

probes.printed: RENAMES A2 THRU B1 over a fixed OCCURS 2 table in between: RT=[bttttc]; MOVE "123456" TO RT -> T1(2)=45 B1=6
probes.expected: intervening table occurrences are inside the span (SR3 bars OCCURS only on data-name-2/3)

probes.expected: the alias spans the record area across WRITE and READ

probes.expected: refused: SR8 data-name-3 subordinate to data-name-2; SR4 not the same data-name

reader.notes: The span is composed by PlaceForRenames over the leaves between the first elementary item of data-name-2 and the last of data-name-3, numeric leaves through their storage image, so moves are byte deposits and comparisons are alphanumeric. The same code runs at every edition; the 1985 range limits (SR3, SR6, SR8) are refused. INITIALIZE of a 66 entry is refused (COBOL0835), which §1985 INITIALIZE SR6 requires too.
